verdict.rationale: EFTPS is an online payment service, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows only email notifications, which are not registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The documented software channel is the Batch Provider program, not an API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the pack documents webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
